name: Montenegro
notes: First pass, national level; very sparse. Geography: 25 municipalities (opštine) with ISO 3166-2:ME codes. Map: 24 municipal shapes (2020 layer; Zeta, created 2022, has no separate shape and is drawn inside Podgorica), matched by ISO 3166-2:ME codes. Shapes: Glaurdić, Kaniški, Budimir & Ondrejka, Spatial Data of Municipalities in Yugoslavia and Its Successor States 1970-2020 (ELWar project, GESIS / University of Luxembourg, doi 10.7802/2358), 2020 layer, CC BY 4.0; made from the official gazettes, not OpenStreetMap. Eurostat GISCO LAU 2024 has no ME units; HDX has no COD-AB; geoBoundaries is OSM-derived ODbL. No Seats tab: no supporter found who sits in the Skupština. Round 2 checked Eurostat GISCO LAU 2023: no ME units, so no map.
